name: Sea lavender rosette (form example)
reference: Limonium carolinianum: a flat basal rosette of broad spoon-shaped leathery green leaves hugging the ground; bloom = one slender stalk from the centre ending in a small pale-lavender flower with a darker centre

notes.why_library_form: growth-form example for the library (lifeboard#25): a basal leaf rosette with a centre flower stalk is exactly rosette
